GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit finding F05 and the reopened M0.7 gap. The durable unit of rollback is a complete generation, not independent code and database switches.

Alternatives.Alternative: Overwrite active files and restore backups on failure. Rejected because crash windows can destroy both active and rollback states.
Keep only an in-memory current revision map. Rejected because fresh-process recovery would reconstruct authority from incomplete state.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: Public signing infrastructure, trust-root rotation, and transparency-log policy remain a later supply-chain change; authenticated system-update metadata is required here.
Storage layout and retention limits are selected during planning from measured package sizes.

Scenarios.Scenario: Power loss occurs after migrated state is written but before selection; restart keeps the prior generation current.
A candidate starts and crashes repeatedly; it is quarantined and recovery launches without executing it.
